excluded_candidates.reason: Uses disable_ppu_safe setup; this phase excludes PPU-dependent candidates and does not claim that setup is inert in the no-PPU profile.
Checks serial clock alignment relative to boot and is explicitly boot-state-dependent; the admitted profile skips the boot ROM.

fixtures.eligibility_basis: Pinned acceptance source exercises the CPU DAA instruction and its input/flag matrix; source declares hardware-verified pass results for DMG, including DMG-CPU-B. It enters at cartridge code and uses no boot ROM or PPU result as an oracle.
fixtures.boot: Skipped; bootless DMG-CPU-B profile starts at the cartridge entry point 0x0100.
fixtures.oracle_class: Mooneye hardware-author acceptance test; source reports DMG pass.

protocol.pass: Registers B,C,D,E,H,L are 3,5,8,13,21,34 at the LD B,B breakpoint; the guest then loops.
protocol.fail: Registers B,C,D,E,H,L are 0x42 at the LD B,B breakpoint; the guest then loops.
protocol.runner_support: Current generic runner does not interpret the Mooneye register protocol; preparation run is recorded separately.
